data.narrative:
Dispatch Space is a private-sector Space & Aerospace company founded by Payton Case and Andrew Mello. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs. Stage and current valuation remain undisclosed.

Two standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable here. The peer-median approach fails due to insufficient same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier matches within the Space & Aerospace sector; while 14 same-sector peers exist broadly, none of the narrow filters yielded the minimum 3 datapoints required for a defensible median. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot proceed: the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 27.4x across the 6 public tickers listed, but Dispatch Space's revenue is not disclosed, precluding revenue-based valuation.

The data constraints prevent quantitative triangulation. Any valuation estimate would require either disclosure of the target's revenue (enabling public-comp anchoring) or identification of 3+ private peers at matching stage and tier (enabling peer-median work). Without these inputs, reliance on sector-level multiples alone would obscure stage, capital structure, and operational differences that typically drive 5–10x variance in early-stage aerospace valuations. Further diligence on financial metrics and transaction precedents in this cohort is prerequisite to a defensible range.
